cover_dek: The U.S. added 165,000 jobs in October as the unemployment rate slipped.
big_headline: The U.S. economy added 165,000 jobs in October, way more than expected.
big_body: Nonfarm payrolls were expected to increase by 59,000. Instead, the U.S. added 165,000 jobs while the unemployment rate slipped to 4.1%.
pol_body: Strive posted $474.8M in Q3 net income to common holders, which is profit belonging to everyday shareholders. This was almost entirely a $533.7M unrealized bitcoin gain.
